title: Rules 3–4: floor and quasi-identifiers
summary: Set a k-anonymity floor so many situations fit, and coarsen the stacks of facts that act like fingerprints.

blocks.title: A floor, then coarsen the stacks
blocks.body: Even a good relationship map fails if the supporting details form a fingerprint. Rules 3 and 4 borrow from privacy engineering: anonymity sets, and quasi-identifiers that only become lethal in combination.

blocks.heading: 3. Set a floor (k-anonymity)
blocks.body:
After encoding, at least k real situations should fit the description. If k is one — only your story matches — you have published an identifier wearing a costume. Aim for a floor where a careful stranger cannot narrow the field to a handful of candidates.

You do not need a formal k. You need the habit: "Could five teams I do not know recognize themselves here without being the subject?" If not, coarsen further.

blocks.title: The floor is a design target
blocks.body: Pick a floor that matches the risk. A soft lesson about handoffs can live with a smaller k. A story that could cost someone a job needs a higher floor — more possible referents, fewer rare traits.

blocks.heading: 4. Coarsen quasi-identifiers
blocks.body:
Quasi-identifiers are facts that are harmless alone and lethal in combination: job title + city + unusual hobby + a specific month. Allegory often leaks through the stack, not through any single colorful detail.

Coarsen each axis until the combination stops being a fingerprint. Turn "the only woman CNC lead in a 40-person shop in Racine who races vintage motorcycles" into "a skilled lead in a small shop who keeps a loud hobby outside work." Same human texture; far fewer bits.

items.label: List the rare traits
items.detail: Titles, places, hobbies, timelines, tools, one-off incidents.

items.label: Ask what combination remains unique
items.detail: If three traits still point at one person you know, drop or blur one.

items.label: Keep one texture cue
items.detail: Flavor is allowed; fingerprints are not.

blocks.title: Stacks leak
blocks.body: One vivid detail is flavor. Three rare details together are a name.
